usage: tensorfold serve [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--name NAME]
                        [--alias ALIAS] [--context CONTEXT]
                        [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temperature TEMPERATURE]
                        [--top-p TOP_P] [--top-k TOP_K]
                        [--thinking | --no-thinking]
                        [--reasoning-effort {low,medium,xhigh}]
                        [--thinking-budget THINKING_BUDGET] [--no-drafts]
                        [--drafter DRAFTER] [--drafter-bits DRAFTER_BITS]
                        [--mtp-drafts MTP_DRAFTS]
                        [--mtp-confidence MTP_CONFIDENCE]
                        [--lane-kernels {auto,on,off}]
                        [--prompt-cache-gib PROMPT_CACHE_GIB]
                        [--checkpoint-slots CHECKPOINT_SLOTS]
                        [--spill-gib SPILL_GIB] [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR]
                        [--max-snapshots MAX_SNAPSHOTS] [--parallel PARALLEL]
                        [--mlx-cache-gib MLX_CACHE_GIB] [--ssd-experts GIB]
                        [--ple-on-ssd] [--no-update-check]
                        [--backend {auto,mlx,cuda}] [--tp {1,2}]
                        [--rank {0,1}] [--master MASTER]
                        [--master-port MASTER_PORT]
                        [--kv-dtype {bf16,int8,int4}]
                        model

positional arguments:
  model                 a Hugging Face repo id (downloaded on first use) or a
                        model directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

endpoint:
  --host HOST           address to listen on (0.0.0.0: every interface)
                        (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port PORT
  --name NAME           model id clients ask for (default: the model's name)
                        (default: )
  --alias ALIAS         another model id to answer to (default: [])

generation (requests can override each of these):
  --context CONTEXT     prompt plus reply window (default: model config; CUDA
                        default/0: affordable native capacity; Metal 0: remove
                        metadata cap) (default: None)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        reply tokens when a request does not say (default:
                        4096)
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
                        0 decodes greedily (default: the model's
                        generation_config.json, else 0) (default: None)
  --top-p TOP_P         (default: the model's generation config) (default:
                        None)
  --top-k TOP_K         (default: the model's generation config) (default:
                        None)
  --thinking, --no-thinking
                        open a think block when the chat template supports it
                        (default: True)
  --reasoning-effort {low,medium,xhigh}
                        for chat templates that take one (Qwen3.8); medium
                        adds no system-prompt text (default: medium)
  --thinking-budget THINKING_BUDGET
                        most thinking tokens before the server closes the
                        think block (0: no limit) (default: 0)

drafting and caches:
  --no-drafts           one token a round: the serial reference (same output,
                        slower) (default: False)
  --drafter DRAFTER     a draft model (repo id or directory); auto: the
                        family's draft model when it has been pulled; none: no
                        draft model (default: auto)
  --drafter-bits DRAFTER_BITS
                        quantize the draft model's linears (0: bf16) (default:
                        4)
  --mtp-drafts MTP_DRAFTS
                        most MTP drafts a round (Qwen3.8 Flash Next: 3 on Mac;
                        on CUDA 6, stopping under 30% confidence); 0: no MTP
                        drafts (any family) (default: None)
  --mtp-confidence MTP_CONFIDENCE
                        on CUDA, stop an MTP chain before a later draft under
                        this probability (Flash Next default 0.30) (default:
                        None)
  --lane-kernels {auto,on,off}
                        lane kernels for Qwen3.8 dense (auto: on GPUs with
                        tensor units) (default: auto)
  --prompt-cache-gib PROMPT_CACHE_GIB
                        memory for cached conversation prefixes (0: off;
                        default: an eighth of RAM, at most 16) (default: None)
  --checkpoint-slots CHECKPOINT_SLOTS
                        cached conversation prefixes kept in memory (default:
                        3 per parallel lane, at least 8); with long
                        conversations this, not --prompt-cache-gib, is usually
                        the limit (default: None)
  --spill-gib SPILL_GIB
                        write evicted conversation prefixes to disk, up to
                        this many GiB, and read them back on demand instead of
                        prefilling again (0: off; needs --snapshot-dir)
                        (default: 0.0)
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        where system-block and conversation snapshots are kept
                        ('none': in memory only) (default:
                        /Users/peter/.cache/tensorfold/prefix-snapshots)
  --max-snapshots MAX_SNAPSHOTS
                        system-block snapshots loaded at start (default: 3)
  --parallel PARALLEL   requests decoded together, their windows sharing each
                        round's forward: a number, or auto (Mac: up to 8, each
                        started only while the projected memory fits the
                        budget; CUDA: one at a time, the others waiting their
                        turn) (default: auto)
  --mlx-cache-gib MLX_CACHE_GIB
                        MLX's cache of freed buffers (default: 8.0)
  --ssd-experts GIB     stream routed experts from the checkpoint into a GPU
                        pool of this many GiB, for models past the memory
                        budget (the rest stays resident; output is the
                        resident model's) (default: None)
  --ple-on-ssd          Flash Next: read the n-gram (PLE) tables from the
                        checkpoint on SSD at each lookup instead of holding
                        them in memory. A trade: a few percent of decode speed
                        for about 40 GiB less at peak (the tables are 29.8
                        GiB); a 128 GB Mac needs it (default: False)
  --no-update-check     don't ask GitHub whether a newer release exists (also
                        TENSORFOLD_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1) (default: False)

NVIDIA GPUs (DGX Spark):
  --backend {auto,mlx,cuda}
                        auto: MLX on macOS, CUDA elsewhere (default: auto)
  --tp {1,2}            GPUs (one per machine) the model is split over; run
                        the same command on each (default: 1)
  --rank {0,1}          with --tp 2: this machine's rank; rank 0 serves HTTP,
                        rank 1 follows it (default: 0)
  --master MASTER       with --tp 2: rank 0's address on the link between the
                        machines (default: )
  --master-port MASTER_PORT
                        with --tp 2: rank 0's rendezvous port (default: 29551)
  --kv-dtype {bf16,int8,int4}
                        KV cache: bf16 (the default), int8, or int4. Quantized
                        keys and values use one fp16 scale per 32 values
                        (changes the output; Flash Next on CUDA only)
                        (default: bf16)
